verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own docs say developers can use webhooks to be notified asynchronously when a transcription job completes, which removes the need to poll. The evidence is a single tutorial sentence, though: it does not show how to register the callback URL, what the payload contains, or that the webhook also fires on job failure. Missing for 10: documented webhook firing on job failure, callback registration and payload details, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a webhook or callback fires when a job completes or fails, so nothing in my system has to poll

citations.quote: use webhooks to asynchronously receive notifications once the transcription job completes.
This tutorial uses the Asynchronous Speech to Text API to produce a transcript of an audio file submitted by you.
